name: Advanced Techniques for Algorithm Design
description: Linear programming: polyhedral geometry, simplex, duality, applications to combinatorial optimization. Randomized algorithms: applications of probability theory, linearity of expectation, concentration bounds. Iterative methods: power iteration, gradient descent, multiplicative weights update, and their applications.
